data.name: Royal Lancaster London
data.hotelDescription:
Luxurious 5-Star London Hotel

Breath-Taking Views: Enjoy stunning views of the London skyline from this quiet 5-star hotel next to Hyde Park.

Exceptional Amenities: Indulge in the free 24/7 gym, two award-winning restaurants, and soundproofed rooms with Smart TVs and heated bathroom floors.

Culinary Delights: Experience authentic Thai cuisine at the Nipa Restaurant, rich meals at the Island Grill, and traditional afternoon tea at the Park Restaurant.

Make your London stay unforgettable at the Royal Lancaster London.
data.hotelImportantInformation:
Please note that private parking is available at the property.

Please note that the gym is for guests aged 18 and over only.

For nonrefundable booking, the cardholder must be present with the card used to make the payment at the hotel at the time of check-in.Please inform  of your expected arrival time in advance. You can use the Special Requests box when booking, or contact the property directly using the contact details in your confirmation.
Guests under the age of 18 can only check in with a parent or official guardian.
A deposit may be required at the property.

categories.description: General sentiment is positive regarding cleanliness, specifically mentioned in several reviews.

categories.name: Service
categories.description: Numerous reviews highlight the exceptional service from staff, particularly mentioning helpfulness and friendliness.

categories.name: Location
categories.description: The location is frequently praised for its convenience and proximity to attractions.

categories.name: Room Quality
categories.description: Rooms are described as clean, comfortable, and well-equipped, contributing to a positive impression.

categories.name: Amenities
categories.description: Some amenities like gym and breakfast quality received mixed reviews, indicating room for improvement.

categories.name: Value for Money
categories.description: Most guests feel that the experience justifies the price, with some minor concerns noted.

categories.name: Food and Beverage
categories.description: Breakfast is positively reviewed, however, there are suggestions to expand the menu.

categories.name: Overall Experience
categories.description: Guests consistently express a strong likelihood of recommending the hotel, highlighting exceptional stays.
